newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: SP Setia unit in Putrajaya project.
newsitem.headline: SP Setia unit in Putrajaya project.

text.p: SP Setia Bhd said on Thursday that a wholly-owned unit has been included in a joint-venture to build residential and commercial properties in Malaysia's new federal administrative capital, Putrajaya.
Teamstead Sdn Bhd, the unit, will be the joint venture company to undertake the project, a statement from SP Setia said.
SP Setia will hold a 50 percent stake in the project which will involve construction of the Putrajaya buildings, including the prime minister's office, home and other government offices.
Other partners in the joint-venture are government-owned Putrajaya Holdings Sdn Bhd, with a 30 percent stake, and an undisclosed Bumiputra (ethnic Malay) investor, with a 20 percent share.
The contract is not expected to have any impact on SP Setia's earnings for the year ended December 31, 1997, the statement said.
It is also not expected to affect share capital or net tangible assets, the statement added.
